name: Claude Code
description: Run and orchestrate Claude Code sessions: fleets of headless sessions in their own worktrees, with Grain's approvals

tools.name: claude_code_run
tools.description: Run Claude Code headless on a repo in its own worktree.

tools.name: claude_code_fleet
tools.description: Start several Claude Code sessions as one fleet.

tools.name: claude_code_status
tools.description: Status of a Claude Code session, or a list of recent ones.

tools.name: claude_code_send
tools.description: Steer a Claude Code session over its open input.

tools.name: claude_code_result
tools.description: Outcome, cost and diff of a Claude Code session.

tools.name: claude_code_wait
tools.description: Wait until Claude Code sessions have settled.

tools.name: claude_code_permission
tools.description: The name of the approval card for a session's permission request; never offered to the model.

claudeCodeMaxConcurrent.title: Claude Code sessions at once
claudeCodeMaxConcurrent.description: How many headless Claude Code sessions may work at the same time. They also count toward the coding session limit. A fleet queues the rest.

claudeCodeDefaultModel.title: Default model
claudeCodeDefaultModel.description: The model id for sessions that do not name one. Empty uses the Claude Code CLI's own default.

claudeCodeDefaultPermissionMode.title: Default permission mode
claudeCodeDefaultPermissionMode.description: How a session asks before editing files or running commands. Whatever it would ask becomes an approval card in the chat that started it.

claudeCodeBudgetUsd.title: Budget per session (USD)
claudeCodeBudgetUsd.description: A session stops after spending this much. 0 means no limit.

claudeCodeMaxTurns.title: Turn limit per session
claudeCodeMaxTurns.description: A session stops after this many turns. 0 means no limit.

claudeCodeWorktreeRoot.title: Worktree folder
claudeCodeWorktreeRoot.description: Where each session's git worktree is made, as <folder>/<repo>/<task>. Never a .claude/worktrees folder: Claude Code cleans those up while sessions run.
